notes:
Summary:
- Mid-size payments platform with embedded customer support for merchant disputes and cardholder inquiries. Heavily regulated: PCI scope + some PHI in billing notes. Must run in VPC with private link to Zendesk and internal data stores.
- Primary goals: real-time agent assist (suggest replies, next-best-action), automated ticket summarization for QA, safe tool-calling (create/close tickets, escalate), and robust behavior during episodic traffic spikes.
Technical / SLOs:
- Target: agent-suggestion latency p95 < 250ms (streaming suggestions preferred), end-to-end reply generation under 800ms.
- Peak concurrency: up to 3k agents during Black Friday-style spikes; average concurrent 600.
- Throughput requirement: sustained 120 requests/sec, bursts to 3k req/sec for short periods.
Model & routing preferences:
- Prefer open models (LLM family) with quantized variants for cost. Want model catalog visibility and verified perf profiles.
- Must support automatic fallback to smaller model variants and routing by cost/latency during saturation.
Security/compliance:
- SSO via SAML, enterprise SCIM, audit logs with 7+ year retention for PCI evidence, KMS/HSM for envelope keys, SOC2 + ISO27001 required.
- Data residency: primary NA, sensitive fields tokenized, retention controls for transcripts (90 days for PII, 7 years for transaction evidence).
POC scope:
- 4-week POC: week1 integration (VPC peering, private link), week2 streaming agent assist prototype (Zendesk UI hooks), week3 load testing (spike patterns), week4 security review + report.
- Deliverables: sample traffic replay, latency/cost dashboard, regression tests on a seed prompt set, runbook for failover.
Stakeholder notes & quotes:
- "Can't expand scope of PCI beyond our payment pipelines" — Head of Compliance.
- CTO: "Need deterministic fallbacks and auditability; if model hallucination risks business loss we must block tool-calls."
Commercials:
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high; open to reserved dedicated pools if unit economics are favorable.
Next steps / actions:
- SE (Luis) to share POC test plan and private-link network diagram by 2026-03-12.
- Security to complete questionnaire (form attached in Drive) — outstanding.
- Legal to draft DPA addendum for PCI data handling.
